filters.notifications: (notifications.sender = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_recipients r WHERE r.notification = notifications.id AND r.recipient = :requester))
filters.notification_recipients: recipient = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.id = notification_recipients.notification AND n.sender = :requester)
filters.notification_references: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.id = notification_references.notification AND (n.sender = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_recipients r WHERE r.notification = n.id AND r.recipient = :requester)))
filters.notification_events: EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notifications n WHERE n.id = notification_events.notification AND (n.sender = :requester OR ((n.sender = :requester OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_recipients r WHERE r.notification = n.id AND r.recipient = :requester)) AND (notification_events.notification_recipient = '' OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM notification_recipients r WHERE r.id = notification_events.notification_recipient AND r.recipient = :requester)))))
